title: Token adherence probe refuses ship on raw palette or missing parity
asA: operator relying on the theme-system discipline
iWant: a runtime check that fails the build when component styles slip a raw hex or when a theme is missing a token pair
soThat: the semantic-token contract in ADR-202 is enforced at the ship gate, not just declared

acceptanceCriteria.description: The token-adherence probe (TAC-207) scans the built component-scope stylesheets and exits non-zero when any file outside the token-realisation file contains a raw palette literal: hex, `rgb(`, `rgba(`, `hsl(`, `hsla(`, `oklch(`, `oklab(`, or a named CSS colour outside the pass-through allow list (`transparent`, `currentColor`, `inherit`, `initial`, `unset`).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project build that shipped a raw `#123456` in a component stylesheet outside `assets/tokens/theme.css`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the token-adherence probe runs against the built stylesheet output
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe exits with a non-zero code and records the file path and line number of the violation in its report

acceptanceCriteria.description: The token-adherence probe reads the design tokens JSON, extracts the light and dark key sets, and exits non-zero when any key present in one theme is missing from the other.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a design tokens JSON in which the light theme declares `surface.raised` but the dark theme does not
acceptanceCriteria.when: the token-adherence probe runs against the tokens file
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe exits with a non-zero code and records the missing key with the theme it is missing from in its report

acceptanceCriteria.description: The token-adherence probe writes a JSON report at a stable relative path (`reports/token-adherence.json` under the configured report directory) naming every stylesheet scanned, every raw-literal violation with file path and line number, every missing-parity token key, and an `ok` or `fail` verdict.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a completed probe run (pass or fail)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the report file is inspected on disk
acceptanceCriteria.then: the JSON at `reports/token-adherence.json` matches the shape declared by TAC-207 and its verdict field agrees with the process exit code

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the token-adherence probe is wired as a gate in the ci-pipeline runner (TAC-701), a non-zero probe exit propagates through the per-gate report (TAC-702) and the aggregate report (TAC-703), and the ci-pipeline runner refuses ship with a non-zero exit.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the ci-pipeline runner configured with the token-adherence probe as a required gate
acceptanceCriteria.when: the probe reports `fail` on any run
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate report records the gate as failed and the runner exits non-zero
